title: Modified ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA/RNA Miniprep Kit for Parallel Extraction from Peat Soil
author: Rhiannon Mondav

steps.title: Prepare Kit Reagents
steps.instruction: Perform initial kit setup and reagent reconstitution.

substeps.instruction: Add 96 ml 100% ethanol (or 104 ml 95% ethanol) to the 24 ml DNA/RNA Wash Buffer concentrate.
Reconstitute lyophilized DNase I with DNase/RNase-Free Water, mix by gentle inversion, and store frozen aliquots at -20°C.

steps.title: Prepare Tubes and Filters
steps.instruction: Set up and label all necessary tubes and filters for each sample.

substeps.instruction: Prepare and label 4 tubes with sample ID (2 labeled 'RNA', 2 labeled 'DNA').
Set up and label 5 collection tubes with sample ID (2 labeled 'DNA', 2 labeled 'RNA').
Place a yellow filter in one collection tube labeled 'DNA'.
Place a green column in one collection tube labeled 'RNA'.
Place HRC filters in two collection tubes, one each labeled 'DNA' and 'RNA'.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare nuclease-free tubes with lysis buffer for each sample.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 400 µl of DNA/RNA Lysis Buffer into one nuclease-free tube per sample.
Label tubes with sample ID.

steps.title: Thaw and Transfer Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the soil sample slurry based on the storage method.

substeps.instruction: For liquid nitrogen flash frozen samples: Transfer 0.25 g sample to a ZR BashingBead Lysis Tube, add 750 µl DNA/RNA Shield, cap tightly, and vortex briefly; vortex briefly 2 or 3 more times during thaw.
For samples collected in DNA/RNA Shield: Retrieve from -80°C, place on ice to thaw, and vortex briefly every five minutes (may take 30 minutes or longer).
Transfer 750 µl of slurry to a ZR BashingBead Lysis Tube using a pre-cut pipette tip (set pipette to 800 µl, vortex briefly or invert before transfer) and cap tightly.

steps.title: Bead Beating
steps.instruction: Mechanically lyse the samples using a bead beater.

substeps.instruction: Label the side of the BB Lysis Tube with sample ID.
Bead beat on MP Bio FastPrep for 60 seconds at 6.5 m/s, then rest for 5 minutes.
Repeat this cycle four more times for a total of 5 minutes of bead beating.

steps.title: Initial Centrifugation and Lysis
steps.instruction: Separate the supernatant and combine with lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at 16,000 x g for 30 seconds.
Transfer 400 µl of the supernatant to the pre-prepared tube containing lysis buffer.
Mix well by inversion (total sample volume is now 800 µl).

steps.title: DNA Capture via Yellow Filter
steps.instruction: Isolate DNA using the Spin-Away filter.

substeps.instruction: Pour or pipette the sample into a yellow Spin-Away™ Filter in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 45 seconds.
Transfer the yellow filter containing DNA into a new Collection Tube and store until step 10.
SAVE the flow-through for RNA extraction.

steps.title: RNA Capture via Green Column
steps.instruction: Isolate RNA from the flow-through of the yellow filter.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 800 µl of 95-100% ethanol into a labeled nuclease-free tube ('RNA').
Transfer the 800 µl flow-through from the yellow filter into the ethanol tube, close tightly, and mix by inversion (total volume 1600 µl).
Transfer 700 µl of this RNA mixture into a prepared Zymo-Spin™ IIICG Column (green) in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 45 seconds and discard flow-through.
Repeat until all RNA solution has passed through the green column.

steps.title: Process Green Column and DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA column and remove contaminating DNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare DNase Master Mix on ice (for 1 sample: 5 µl DNase I and 75 µl DNase digestion buffer; for 6 samples: 30 µl DNase I and 450 µl buffer; for 8 samples: 40 µl DNase I and 600 µl buffer; for 12 samples: 60 µl DNase I and 900 µl buffer; for 24 samples: 120 µl DNase I and 1800 µl buffer).
Add 400 µl DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to the green column, centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 45 seconds, and discard flow-through.
Add 80 µl DNase I Master Mix to the green column and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Wash and Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Clean and elute the DNA from the yellow filter.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µl DNA/RNA Prep Buffer to the yellow filter, centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 30 seconds, and discard flow-through.
Add 700 µl DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to the yellow filter, centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 30 seconds, and discard flow-through.
Add 400 µl DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to the yellow filter and centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 2 minutes to ensure complete removal of buffer.
Carefully transfer the column into a new tube and discard the old tube and flow-through.
Add 100 µl ZymoBIOMICS™ DNase/RNase-Free Water directly to the yellow filter matrix.
Incubate for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 30 seconds to elute DNA and RNA.

steps.title: Prepare HRC Filter
steps.instruction: Prepare the High Recovery Column filter.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µl ZymoBIOMICS™ HRC Prep Solution to a Zymo-Spin™ III-HRC Filter in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 3 minutes.
Discard the collection tube and flow-through.
Transfer the prepared III-HRC Filter to a new tube.

steps.title: Final DNA/RNA Recovery
steps.instruction: Recover the eluted nucleic acids using the HRC filter.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the eluted DNA and RNA from the yellow filter into the prepared Zymo-Spin™ III-HRC Filter.
Centrifuge at exactly 16,000 x g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Sample Storage and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Finalize samples for storage and testing.

substeps.instruction: Discard the filter, close the tube lid, and place on ice.
Pipette 3 to 10 µl of each sample into new tubes for purity, quantity, and quality testing.
Store actual samples in -20°C or -80°C freezers.
Optionally create 5 µl and 10 µl aliquots for downstream testing.
